entries.label: 2026 T1 filing deadline (self-employed and spouse)
entries.notes: Tuesday. Filing only; balance owing still due Apr 30. Duplicate of tax-deadlines-2026.json for the self-employment file.
entries.source_note: CRA important-dates page + Reinvest Wealth 2026 guide + Wealthsimple guide (verified 2026-09-29).

entries.label: 2026 balance owing deadline (self-employed included)
entries.notes: Friday. Interest accrues from May 1, compounded daily.
entries.source_note: CRA important-dates page + Reinvest Wealth 2026 guide (verified 2026-09-29).

entries.label: 2026 self-employed CPP base contribution rate
entries.notes: Both halves (11.9%) paid on Schedule 8. Employee equivalent is 5.95%.

entries.label: 2026 self-employed maximum base CPP contribution
entries.notes: 11.9% of ($74,600 - $3,500). Duplicate of cpp-2026.json for the self-employment file.

entries.label: 2026 self-employed CPP2 contribution rate
entries.notes: 8% on earnings between YMPE $74,600 and YAMPE $85,000.

entries.label: 2026 self-employed maximum CPP2 contribution
entries.notes: Duplicate of cpp-2026.json CPP2 figure for the self-employment file.

entries.label: EI premiums for self-employed (default)
entries.notes: Opt-in only via Service Canada agreement; then employee rate only, no employer half; Schedule 13. No regular EI benefits.
entries.value: No EI premiums unless opted into EI special benefits program

entries.label: Individual instalment threshold (net tax owing)
entries.notes: Must exceed the threshold in the current year AND in either of the two preceding years.
entries.source_note: CRA 'Who has to pay - Required tax instalments for individuals' (crawled 2026-09-20).

entries.label: Individual instalment due dates
entries.notes: Shift to the next business day if the date falls on a weekend/holiday.

entries.label: GST/HST small-supplier registration threshold
entries.notes: Rolling test: single calendar quarter OR four consecutive calendar quarters; revenue (not profit); worldwide taxable supplies; blow-out rule registers from the crossing sale.
entries.source_note: Modern Axis 2026 guide + MapleInvoice ETA s.148/240 explainer (verified 2026-09-29). Secondary sources; threshold itself is statute.

entries.label: GST/HST quick method revenue cap
entries.notes: Worldwide taxable supplies under this cap may elect the quick method (flat remittance percentage instead of tracking ITCs).

entries.label: Business-use-of-home eligibility tests (T2125 line 9945)
entries.notes: Meet ONE test. Prorate by area; further prorate by hours if mixed use. Cannot create/increase a loss (carry-forward). Never claim CCA on the home-office share (principal-residence-exemption risk).
entries.value: Principal place of business, OR used exclusively and on a regular/ongoing basis to meet clients/customers/patients
